name: PyTorch 合集
description: PyTorch 框架使用：张量、广播、自动微分、模块与训练流程。
description_en: Using the PyTorch framework: tensors, broadcasting, automatic differentiation, modules, and the training loop.

name: 算子合集
description: 手写神经网络激活、归一化、卷积/注意力、损失与优化器更新等核心算子，支持多实现语言（当前 PyTorch）。
description_en: Hand-write core neural network operators — activations, normalization, convolution/attention, losses, and optimizer updates — with support for multiple implementation languages (currently PyTorch).

name: AI 系统性能合集
description: 训练/推理系统的性能与显存账：激活估算、梯度检查点、FLOPs/MFU、算子融合与 Roofline。续批补上内存侧的逐步账本：缓存分配器的 best-fit 块分配/扩段/相邻空闲合并、激活生命周期区间上的偏移规划与峰值下界、Offload 单引擎多缓冲预取与计算重叠的时间线账。
description_en: Performance and GPU memory accounting for training/inference systems: activation estimation, gradient checkpointing, FLOPs/MFU, operator fusion, and Roofline. The follow-up adds step-by-step memory ledgers: caching-allocator best-fit block allocation with segment growth and free-block coalescing, offset planning over activation lifetime intervals with a peak lower bound, and the compute-transfer overlap timeline of a single-engine multi-buffer offload prefetch pipeline.

name: 分布式训练原语合集
description: 集合通信与多维并行基础：Broadcast / Gather / Scatter / All-Gather / Reduce-Scatter / All-Reduce / All-to-All、Ring All-Reduce 逐步模拟、分布式梯度裁剪，以及 ZeRO 通信量 / Offload / Infinity / 分片归属、GPipe 气泡率、1F1B 激活显存、张量及序列·上下文并行通信、次线性检查点与选择性重算背包。续批覆盖多维 rank 坐标与通信组、TP Column/Row 重排及词表并行交叉熵、FSDP 分块预取与前反向通信账、DDP 各 rank 梯度就绪和桶序约束、排除本地路由的 EP 网络通信量、检查点恢复假设下的弹性重映射、资源受限的 V 形放置任务时间线，以及 NCCL 启发的六候选校准代价与交叉阈值。最后把 Ring Attention 也做成逐步可算的版本：KV 块在环上倒转、在线 softmax 逐块修正、因果整块跳过，以及只计 C-1 步的通信账。全部为 CPU 确定性模拟，教学调度及成本模型不冒充真实框架实现。
description_en: Collectives and multidimensional parallelism: Broadcast / Gather / Scatter / All-Gather / Reduce-Scatter / All-Reduce / All-to-All, stepwise Ring All-Reduce, distributed gradient clipping, ZeRO communication / offload / infinity / shard ownership, GPipe bubbles, 1F1B activations, tensor and sequence/context-parallel communication, sublinear checkpointing and selective recomputation. The follow-up covers rank coordinates and groups, TP Column/Row reconstruction and vocab-parallel cross-entropy, FSDP block prefetch and forward/backward communication accounting, per-rank DDP readiness and bucket ordering, EP network volume excluding local routes, checkpoint-backed elastic remapping, resource-constrained V-placement timelines, and NCCL-inspired six-candidate calibrated costs and crossover thresholds. It closes with a stepwise Ring Attention replay: KV blocks walking the ring backwards, per-block online-softmax correction, whole-block causal skipping, and a communication bill charged only C-1 times. All are deterministic CPU simulations; educational schedules and cost models are explicitly distinguished from real framework implementations.

name: 大模型结构合集
description: 像 transformers 库那样逐个组件实现现代 LLM（Qwen2 为骨干，泛用于 Llama/Mistral/DeepSeek）：RMSNorm、RoPE、SwiGLU MLP、GQA 因果注意力、Pre-Norm Decoder Layer，拼装成完整因果语言模型，并延伸 DeepSeek-V3 的 MLA 多头潜在注意力（低秩潜在压缩 + 解耦 RoPE）。每题以同权重喂 transformers eager 参考实现对拍。本批再补 2 题：MLA 权重吸收后的解码（q_nope 先吸收 W_UK 到潜在空间打分、RoPE 项单独相加，概率对 c_KV 池化后一次性用 W_UV 升维，与未吸收的逐 token 展开前向逐位对拍）、MTP 多 token 预测的深度融合栈（h^k=M_k[RMS(h^{k−1})‖RMS(Emb(x_{i+k}))]、M_k∈R^{d×2d}，深度串行、嵌入偏移取 k+1）。本批再补 6 题：YaRN/LongRoPE 全长外推（β_fast/β_slow 波长 ramp + 重算整张 cos/sin + logit 缩放，linear 插值与 dynamic NTK 作退化档位）、Gemma2 整层（滑窗/全局交替掩码 + 注意力 tanh softcap + 双 post-norm + (1+w) RMSNorm）、SoftMax1/LLN（分母 +1 的注意力 sink，行和 <1 且缺口即 sink 权重）、Mixture-of-Depths 前向（逐层容量取 top-k、router 分数乘 block 输出、未选中位仅残差）、Squared-ReLU 注意力（relu²(logits) 行归一整前向，可叠 QK-Norm），以及收口的 Gemma2 整模型装配（从 config 推导 head_dim/n_head_kv/layer_types、词表头按 tie 绑定、嵌入乘 sqrt(hidden) 与末端 logit softcap，端到端对拍 HF Gemma2ForCausalLM）。
description_en: Implement a modern LLM component by component the way the transformers library does (Qwen2 as the backbone, generalized to Llama/Mistral/DeepSeek): RMSNorm, RoPE, SwiGLU MLP, GQA causal attention, Pre-Norm Decoder Layer, assembled into a complete causal language model, and extended to DeepSeek-V3's MLA multi-head latent attention (low-rank latent compression + decoupled RoPE). Each problem is cross-checked against the transformers eager reference implementation fed identical weights. This batch adds 2 more: MLA decoding after weight absorption (q_nope first absorbs W_UK to score in the latent space with the RoPE term added separately, then the attention probabilities pool c_KV and a single W_UV lift produces the output, cross-checked bit-for-bit against the unabsorbed per-token expansion), and the MTP multi-token-prediction deep fusion stack (h^k=M_k[RMS(h^{k−1})‖RMS(Emb(x_{i+k}))] with M_k∈R^{d×2d}, serial in depth with embedding offset k+1). This batch adds 6 more: full-length YaRN/LongRoPE extrapolation (the beta_fast/beta_slow wavelength ramp, a recomputed cos/sin table and the logit scale, with linear interpolation and dynamic NTK as degenerate modes), the Gemma2 layer (alternating sliding/global masks with attention tanh softcapping, dual post-norms and (1+w) RMSNorm), SoftMax1/LLN (an attention sink that adds 1 to the denominator, so rows sum to less than 1 and the deficit is the sink weight), the Mixture-of-Depths forward pass (per-layer top-k capacity, router scores multiplying the block output, skipped tokens contributing only the residual), Squared-ReLU attention (a full relu-squared forward with row normalization and optional QK-Norm), and the closing full-Gemma2 assembly (head_dim/n_head_kv/layer_types derived from a config, an LM head tied by tie_word_embeddings, the sqrt(hidden) embedding scale and the final logit softcap, compared end to end against HF Gemma2ForCausalLM).

name: 优化器与调度合集
description: 以 PyTorch 训练组件方式出题（多数继承 torch.optim.Optimizer 实现 step() 就地更新，另有 LRScheduler 子类与 EMA 机制对象），区别于函数式单步算子题。核心四题 AdamW 解耦权重衰减、Lion 符号动量、Adafactor 因子分解二阶矩 + RMS 更新裁剪、Muon Newton-Schulz 正交化动量；自适应家族 AdaBelief 置信二阶矩、RAdam 整流稳定系数、AdaBound 动态学习率夹逼、AdamP 尺度不变径向投影；LLM 前沿 NovoGrad 逐层标量二阶矩、Yogi 符号自适应、Tiger sign+动量、ADOPT 修正偏差时序、Cautious 方向一致性掩码、Prodigy D-Adaptation 在线估 lr；调度与机制 warmup+余弦退火、梯度累积+全局范数裁剪+动量 SGD、EMA 权重滑动平均含升温。每题由评测构造待优化对象、喂固定序列反复 step()/update()，与原生 torch.optim 或独立纯 torch 重算参照逐元素对拍；公式回源核实到论文与 kozistr/pytorch_optimizer 实现，CPU float32 保确定性。
description_en: Problems are posed as PyTorch training components (most subclass torch.optim.Optimizer and implement step() with in-place updates; there are also LRScheduler subclasses and an EMA mechanism object), as opposed to functional single-step operator problems. The four core problems are AdamW decoupled weight decay, Lion sign momentum, Adafactor factorized second moment + RMS update clipping, and Muon Newton-Schulz orthogonalized momentum; the adaptive family covers AdaBelief confidence second moment, RAdam rectification stabilization coefficient, AdaBound dynamic learning-rate clamping, and AdamP scale-invariant radial projection; LLM frontier methods include NovoGrad per-layer scalar second moment, Yogi sign adaptivity, Tiger sign+momentum, ADOPT bias-corrected temporal ordering, Cautious direction-consistency masking, and Prodigy D-Adaptation online lr estimation; schedules and mechanisms include warmup+cosine annealing, gradient accumulation+global-norm clipping+momentum SGD, and EMA weight moving average with warmup. For each problem the evaluator constructs the object to be optimized, feeds a fixed sequence of repeated step()/update() calls, and cross-checks element-wise against native torch.optim or an independent pure-torch recomputation; formulas are traced back and verified against the papers and the kozistr/pytorch_optimizer implementation, with CPU float32 for determinism.

name: 分词与数据整理合集
description: LLM 数据管线的两端：BPE 训练与编码、Unigram Viterbi 最优切分、变长序列 padding/packing、SFT 助手损失掩码、因果移位标签与逐轮权重。续批补齐 GPT-2 字节级预分词、BERT/RoBERTa 句对特殊 token 模板、Added Token 最长匹配隔离、UTF-8 字节/字符偏移对齐、固定 ChatML 格式及正文角色字节边界、显式随机数驱动的 Unigram 全路径后验采样、Aho–Corasick 多模式替换、保护特殊位置的预算截断，以及词频/OOV 覆盖率统计，另按 DistributedSampler 口径实现 rank 分片（步数公式、从头补齐、跨步切片与全局覆盖账），以及 WordPiece 贪心最长匹配切分（词级 UNK、续接前缀与码点偏移）与 MinHash 签名 + LSH 分带的近重复去重骨架，并把多源数据集混采也做成确定性流水线（温度权重、最大余额配额、平滑排布与循环越采样）。均为 CPU 确定性练习；各题明确无规范化等范围限制，固定模板不等于完整 Jinja，字节数不冒称真实模型 token 数，自定义截断规则不等同某版 tokenizer 的全部行为。
description_en: Both ends of the LLM data pipeline: BPE training and encoding, Unigram Viterbi segmentation, variable-length padding/packing, assistant-only SFT masks, causal labels, and per-turn weights. Follow-ups cover GPT-2 byte-level pretokenization, BERT/RoBERTa special-token pair templates, longest-match added-token isolation, UTF-8 byte/character offsets, fixed ChatML formatting with content-role byte spans, Unigram full-path posterior sampling driven by explicit uniforms, Aho–Corasick replacement, budget truncation with protected positions, and token-frequency/OOV coverage, plus a DistributedSampler-style rank shard (step formula, head padding, strided slice and a global coverage ledger), and WordPiece greedy longest-match segmentation with word-level UNK, continuation prefixes and code-point offsets, plus the MinHash signature / LSH banding skeleton for near-duplicate dedup, and the multi-source blend as its own pipeline: temperature weights, largest-remainder quota, smooth scheduling and cyclic oversampling. Deterministic CPU exercises with explicit scope restrictions: fixed formatting is not a complete Jinja engine, byte counts are not model-token counts, and custom truncation rules do not claim full equivalence to a particular tokenizer version.

name: 量化与低精度合集
description: 从「怎么量」到「量完怎么算」的量化谱系：per-tensor 对称/非对称 fake-quant、按通道与按分组（GPTQ/AWQ 的 INT4 粒度）的更细量化、weight-only INT8 反量化矩阵乘（推理落地），以及低位宽浮点的数值边界——FP16 动态 loss scaling 的上/下溢与 FP8(E4M3) 就近舍入往返。另附 LLM 压缩主流算法的算法骨架（对齐 LightCompress/LLMC 支持的量化方案）：SmoothQuant 激活离群迁移、AWQ 激活感知缩放、LLM.int8() 离群列混合精度、QuaRot Hadamard 旋转、GPTQ 逐列 Hessian 误差补偿、SpQR 稀疏离群保留。续批 6 题覆盖 BitNet b1.58 三值量化、MX Microscaling E8M0 共享指数、BlockFP 1×128 tile 量化、per-group 非对称 uint4 打包解包、RTN 与 GPTQ 输出误差统计、Hadamard 变换递归构造。再三题补 kernel 级落地与超参搜索：AWQ-Marlin 交错列序的 INT4 权重/零点 tile 重排解码（按给出的置换索引数组还原逻辑列序）、SmoothQuant α 网格搜索（W8A8 双侧 fake-quant + 输出 MSE 选优）、AWQ 缩放指数与裁剪阈值的二维网格搜索（几何归一化、max_shrink 下界、层全局裁剪与分组 int4）。均经内置 torch 量化/float8 oracle 或独立纯 Python 重算对拍；Marlin 布局属实现技巧无对应论文，题面公式为唯一口径。续批三题取自 Awesome-LLM-Compression 量化章节里有公开源码的论文：OmniQuant（arXiv:2308.13137）的等价变换与权重裁剪两阶段块内搜索、AdaRound（arXiv:2004.10568）按重构误差逐元素挑 up/down 的自适应舍入、Bias Compensation（arXiv:2404.01892）用浮点/量化输出差流式更新逐通道偏置。三题均按上游仓库（llm-quantization/omniquant、addoumie/adround-llm、GongCheng1919/bias-compensation）的源码口径实现并与纯 Python oracle 对拍。再补一题 ShiftAddLLM（arXiv:2406.05981，NeurIPS 2024）：按 GATECH-EIC/ShiftAddLLM 的 quantizers/bcq_quant/bcq_shift.py 口径，先把权重按行主序展平切组、用 wf 全 1 的贪心位平面分解，再把每平面标度压成若干有符号 2 的幂之和（ApOT），并用分解后的标度重建，与纯 Python 标量 oracle 对拍。再补 KV 侧五题，同样取自 Awesome-LLM-Compression 里带源码的条目：QAQ（arXiv 2403.04643）由注意力误差预算反解逐单元位宽（正态分位码表与截尾离群比例都作显式入参）、GEAR（arXiv 2403.05527）把量化残差拆成「离群元稀疏项 + 幂迭代低秩项」再合并、PolarQuant 按 RoPE 的前后半对折成极坐标后分组量化角度与半径并打包成单字、vqllm（arXiv 2410.15704）先除以每 token 标准差再做多套码本的残差向量量化、Lexico（arXiv 2412.08890）用固定字典跑逐行 OMP 并把原子 id 与权重摊成 CSR。五题的 scipy 分位表、K-SVD 字典与码本一律离线给定作入参，判题走独立 numpy/纯 Python 重算对拍。
description_en: The quantization spectrum from "how to quantize" to "how to compute after quantizing": per-tensor symmetric/asymmetric fake-quant, finer-grained per-channel and per-group quantization (the INT4 granularity of GPTQ/AWQ), weight-only INT8 dequantized matrix multiplication (inference deployment), and the numerical boundaries of low-bit floating point — FP16 dynamic loss scaling upper/lower overflow and FP8(E4M3) round-to-nearest round trip. Also included are algorithm skeletons of mainstream LLM compression methods (aligned with the quantization schemes supported by LightCompress/LLMC): SmoothQuant activation outlier migration, AWQ activation-aware scaling, LLM.int8() outlier-column mixed precision, QuaRot Hadamard rotation, GPTQ column-wise Hessian error compensation, and SpQR sparse outlier retention. The second batch of 6 covers BitNet b1.58 ternary quantization, MX Microscaling E8M0 shared exponents, BlockFP 1×128 tile quantization, per-group asymmetric uint4 pack/unpack, RTN vs GPTQ output error statistics, and recursive Hadamard transform construction. Three more add kernel-level deployment and hyperparameter search: decoding AWQ-Marlin's interleaved-column INT4 weight/zero tiles back to logical column order through a supplied permutation index array, SmoothQuant α grid search with W8A8 two-sided fake quantization scored by output MSE, and AWQ's 2-D grid over scaling exponent and clipping threshold (geometric normalization, a max_shrink floor, layer-global clipping, and group int4). All are cross-checked against the built-in torch quantization/float8 oracle or an independent pure-Python recomputation; the Marlin layout is an implementation technique with no accompanying paper, so the problem statement's formula is the sole specification. A third batch draws from papers with public code in the Quantization section of Awesome-LLM-Compression: OmniQuant's (arXiv:2308.13137) two-stage in-block search over equivalent transforms and weight clipping, AdaRound's (arXiv:2004.10568) adaptive rounding that picks up/down per element by reconstruction error, and Bias Compensation's (arXiv:2404.01892) streaming per-channel output correction from the float-vs-quantized output gap. All three follow the upstream repositories (llm-quantization/omniquant, addoumie/adround-llm, GongCheng1919/bias-compensation) and are cross-checked against a pure-Python oracle. One more covers ShiftAddLLM (arXiv:2406.05981, NeurIPS 2024): following `quantizers/bcq_quant/bcq_shift.py` in GATECH-EIC/ShiftAddLLM, it flattens the weight row-major into groups, runs the all-ones-`wf` greedy bit-plane decomposition, compresses each plane's scale into a short signed sum of powers of two (ApOT), and reconstructs with the decomposed scales, cross-checked against a pure-Python scalar oracle. Five more cover the KV side, again from entries with public code in Awesome-LLM-Compression: QAQ (arXiv 2403.04643) inverts an attention error budget into per-unit bit widths (the normal quantile table and the outlier clipping ratio are explicit inputs), GEAR (arXiv 2403.05527) splits the quantisation residual into a sparse outlier term plus a power-iteration low-rank term, PolarQuant folds each RoPE half-pair into polar coordinates and quantises angle and radius per group before packing both codes into one word, vqllm (arXiv 2410.15704) normalises every token by its own standard deviation before running multi-codebook residual vector quantisation, and Lexico (arXiv 2412.08890) runs row-wise OMP over a fixed dictionary and flattens the atom ids and weights into CSR. The scipy quantile tables, K-SVD dictionaries and codebooks are all supplied offline as inputs, and each problem is cross-checked against an independent numpy or pure-Python recomputation.

name: 采样策略合集
description: LLM 解码头的数据驱动采样管线：从截断类（top-k / top-p / min-p / typical / top-n-sigma）、免超参的 p-less 家族，到惩罚类（repeat+freq+present、DRY 的反 n-gram Z-algorithm），再到带状态的自适应类（mirostat-v2 困惑度控制、adaptive-p 的 EMA 塑形）与动态温度。以 llama.cpp 源码与 p-less 论文（arXiv:2509.23234）为准；随机数以显式入参 u 注入、自适应类状态作显式入/出参，保证判题确定性，每题另设独立 oracle 对拍。
description_en: The data-driven sampling pipeline of the LLM decoding head: from truncation families (top-k / top-p / min-p / typical / top-n-sigma) and the hyperparameter-free p-less family, to penalty families (repeat+freq+present, DRY's anti-n-gram Z-algorithm), to stateful adaptive families (mirostat-v2 perplexity control, adaptive-p EMA shaping) and dynamic temperature. Based on the llama.cpp source code and the p-less paper (arXiv:2509.23234); random numbers are injected as an explicit input u and adaptive state is passed as explicit input/output, guaranteeing judging determinism, and each problem additionally has an independent oracle for cross-checking.

name: MoE 路由与专家并行合集
description: 混合专家模型的路由与分发管线：top-k gating 与 renorm、Switch / CV / 序列级三种负载均衡辅助损失、位置式 capacity 分派与 token dropping、router z-loss 稳定性正则、Expert-Choice 反序路由、专家并行下的 all-to-all 分派与加权合并；并补充 sigmoid+偏置的分组 aux-free 路由、常开共享专家合成、带显式噪声的 top-k 门控、软限幅的专家 logit 夹逼、Sinkhorn 均衡的迭代归一化、按专家排序后的分组执行计划、概率抖动下的优先级容量分派、跨 step 的负载 EMA 与死专家账本，以及分组矩阵乘的 offsets 切分与前反向。算法对齐 HF Mixtral / Megatron-LM / Shazeer 稀疏门控 / DeepSeek 风格共享专家与无辅助损失均衡、transformers 的 grouped_mm fallback 等公开实现，逐题独立 oracle 对拍。
description_en: The routing and dispatch pipeline of mixture-of-experts models: top-k gating with renorm, Switch / CV / sequence-level load-balancing losses, position-based capacity dispatch with token dropping, router z-loss regularization, Expert-Choice reverse routing, and all-to-all dispatch with weighted combination under expert parallelism. It also covers sigmoid-plus-bias grouped auxiliary-loss-free routing, always-on shared-expert composition, top-k gating with explicit noise, soft clamping of expert logits, Sinkhorn balancing by iterative normalisation, the grouped execution plan over expert-sorted tokens, priority-based capacity dispatch under probability jitter, the cross-step load EMA and dead-expert ledger, and the ragged grouped matrix multiply split by offsets with its forward and backward. Algorithms follow public HF Mixtral / Megatron-LM / Shazeer sparse gating / DeepSeek-style shared-expert and auxiliary-loss-free balancing designs and the transformers grouped_mm fallback, with an independent oracle per problem for cross-checking.

name: LLM 推理 Serving 合集
description: 持续 batching 调度、推测解码拒绝采样、beam search、paged KV block 分配、LRU 驱逐、chunked prefill、prefix-cache 命中、正则文法约束下的 token 掩码、TTFT/TPOT 时间线、每步 token 预算的 prefill 准入背包；续批补 RadixAttention 式前缀树的共享前缀插入与 LRU 叶子淘汰、prefill/decode 抢占时 swap 与 recompute 两条恢复路径的代价计算、优先级+老化调度，以及 PD 分离下 KV 跨节点搬运、TP 环形复制与 decode 副本显存准入的放置账。
description_en: Continuous batching scheduling, speculative decoding rejection sampling, beam search, paged KV block allocation, LRU eviction, chunked prefill, prefix-cache hits, regex-grammar token masks, TTFT/TPOT timelines, and per-step prefill-admission knapsacks; follow-ups add RadixAttention-style prefix-tree insertion with LRU leaf eviction, cost comparison of the swap and recompute recovery paths under prefill/decode preemption, and priority scheduling with aging, plus the placement ledger for disaggregated prefill/decode: KV handoff across nodes, TP ring replication, and decode-replica memory admission.

name: KV Cache 压缩合集
description: 对齐 NVIDIA/kvpress 开源项目的 14 个代表性 KV 压缩算法：位置类 StreamingLLM sink+窗、无注意力 KNorm 反范数、基于注意义的 SnapKV 窗口+avg_pool 与 ObservedAttention 历史均分与 ExpectedAttention 高斯期望、多注意义聚合 TOVA 与全局 head-adaptive AdaKV 剪枝、金字塔层预算分配 PyramidKV、ThinK channel-wise 剪枝、Merging 驱逐合并；第二批补上包装器式 ChunkPress 分块独立 top-k、ChunkKV 语义块整体保留、KeyRerotation 驱逐后 RoPE 重旋转、DuoAttention 检索头/流式头分区。每题以小型 toy 张量为入参、将真实 forward hook 中需的部分拆开直接给定（attn、window queries、mu/cov、已选 n_kept、indices 等）保障确定性，另设独立 oracle 对拍。 第三批按两个 awesome list（Awesome-KV-Cache-Compression、Awesome-LLM-Compression 的 KV Cache 章节）逐个回源上游实现后补 16 题：Quest 页级 key min/max 上界估计、KVzip 跨 query 取 max 的全局阈值、MInference prefill 结构 pattern 搜索、R-KV key 余弦冗余负向打分、TriAttention 逆转 RoPE 的相位打分、CapKV 杠杆分、FastKV 跨层 token 选择性传播、Q-Trust two-hop 注意力传播、HOMER 二叉树层级合并、ZSMerge 零丢弃加权合并、MorphKV 岛状融合、LoCoCo 卷积重算合并、Palu 分组秩预算、xKV 跨层共享奇异向量、Sparse-dLLM 扩散 LLM 的延迟一步驱逐、SepLLM separator 缓存；同样把模型前向中的注意力/键值/超参拆成显式入参。 B 档再补 5 题：LogQuant 预填充与解码共享的那套全精度索引折叠调度（只算索引、不算量化误差），以及 OTT 以 |K| 最小幅值为判据的跨量化步追踪集（门槛取已追踪集合里第 sink_num 小的分数、整张表按分数稳定重排、量化流里换成逐 head 的跨 token 均值占位），以及 ReST-KV 的「赔率分 × 逐层输出重建乘子」：末窗注意力先取 p/(1−p) 再乘上该 value 与历史代表 value 的输出差范数、一维池化平滑后 top-k，并保留 before/after 两种聚合顺序与 use_norm/tau 两个在另一条支路上完全失效的开关，以及 SCOPE 解码期那套由类级计数器驱动的窗口预算——预算每 delta 个 token 才长 1（计数器按「每层调用」推进而不是按 token），discontinuous 再叠一道攒满 delta×num_hidden_layers 次才动一次的突发门，驱逐时冻结的 prompt 前缀与末尾 recent 窗口都不参与竞争、中段按分数降序 topk 且保持分数序落位；以及 Page-EntroKV 的 GQA 组内 Rényi 熵加权页池化：每个 query head 先算 sink 隔离后的熵、组内按 softmax(-熵/tau_g) 加权把原始注意力池成一条，零填充到 block 整数倍后每页取 max，再按 (batch, kv head) 取页级 top-k。
description_en: 14 representative KV compression algorithms aligned with the NVIDIA/kvpress open-source project: the positional StreamingLLM sink+window, attention-free KNorm inverse norm, attention-based SnapKV window+avg_pool alongside ObservedAttention historical mean and ExpectedAttention Gaussian expectation, multi-attention aggregation TOVA with global head-adaptive AdaKV pruning, pyramid layer budget allocation PyramidKV, ThinK channel-wise pruning, and Merging eviction-and-merge; the second batch adds the wrapper-style ChunkPress chunked independent top-k, ChunkKV semantic-chunk whole retention, KeyRerotation RoPE re-rotation after eviction, and DuoAttention retrieval-head/streaming-head partitioning. Each problem takes small toy tensors as input and directly supplies, split out, the parts needed inside a real forward hook (attn, window queries, mu/cov, the selected n_kept, indices, etc.) to ensure determinism, with an additional independent oracle for cross-checking. The third batch adds 16 problems, each traced back to its upstream implementation, from two awesome lists (Awesome-KV-Cache-Compression and the KV Cache section of Awesome-LLM-Compression): Quest page-level key min/max upper-bound estimation, KVzip max-over-query aggregation with a global threshold, MInference prefill structural pattern search, R-KV negative cosine-redundancy scoring, TriAttention inverse-RoPE phase scoring, CapKV leverage scores, FastKV token-selective propagation across layers, Q-Trust two-hop attention propagation, HOMER binary-tree hierarchical merging, ZSMerge zero-drop weighted merging, MorphKV island fusion, LoCoCo convolutional re-combination, Palu grouped rank-budget allocation, xKV cross-layer shared singular vectors, Sparse-dLLM delayed one-step eviction for diffusion LLMs, and SepLLM separator caching; attention scores, K/V, and hyper-parameters from the model forward are likewise exposed as explicit inputs. The B-tier adds 5 more: LogQuant's full-precision index folding schedule shared between prefill and decode (index bookkeeping only, no quantization error), and OTT's cross-step traced set keyed on the smallest |K| magnitudes (threshold at the sink_num-th smallest score already traced, stable whole-table re-sort, and a per-head token-mean placeholder left in the quantized stream), and ReST-KV's "odds score x layer-wise output-reconstruction multiplier": the recent-window attention first becomes p/(1-p) and is scaled by the output-space distance between that value and the representative value compressed out of the history, smoothed by a 1-D pooling and then top-k, keeping both aggregation orders (before/after) and the two switches use_norm/tau that are entirely inert on the other branch., and SCOPE's decoding-phase window budget driven by class-level counters — the budget grows by 1 only every delta tokens (the counters advance per layer call rather than per token), discontinuous stacks a burst gate that fires once delta*num_hidden_layers calls have accumulated, and eviction never touches the frozen prompt prefix or the trailing recent window while the middle region is taken as a descending top-k left in score order. and Page-EntroKV's in-group Rényi-entropy-weighted page pooling: each query head gets a sink-isolated entropy, the group is weighted by softmax(-entropy/tau_g) to pool the raw attention into one curve, that curve is zero-padded to a multiple of the block size and reduced with per-page max, and pages are then top-k'ed per (batch, kv head).

name: 对齐与训练目标合集
description: RLHF/对齐链路的 21 个训练目标与优势估计算子：DPO 直接偏好优化损失（策略与参考策略对数比组装成 Bradley-Terry logistic 目标）、PPO/GRPO 截断代理目标（概率比 exp(Δlogprob) 的 min+clip 信任域）、Bradley-Terry 奖励模型损失（末位有效 token 池化 + 价值头打分 + 成对排序）、Label Smoothing 交叉熵（软标签拆成 NLL 与均匀分布 KL 正则两项）；扩展批次含 GAE 广义优势估计（反向递推 advantages/returns）、PPO 价值函数裁剪（新旧估值与回报的 max-of-squares）、GRPO 组内标准化优势（按 group 求均值与有偏标准差）、KTO 前景理论损失（相对参考点的 desirable/undesirable 价值）、SimPO 长度归一化偏好损失（平均对数概率作奖励 + 目标边际）、PPO 自适应 KL 系数控制器（比例误差截断后平滑调节）。续批补入 11 题：ORPO 无参考模型赔率比损失（SFT 项 + λ·赔率项，长度归一后再取稳定 log-odds）、IPO 平方目标边际损失（Δ 拉向 1/(2β)，不乘 β）、cDPO 对称标签噪声平滑（ε=0 退化为 DPO）、GKD 广义 JSD 在线蒸馏（温度缩放 + 概率空间混合分布 + 未缩放 logits 的硬标签 CE）、MiniLM 逐头注意力 KL 与关系表示 MSE 蒸馏、RLOO 留一基线优势（分母 G-1、组内零和）、Dr. GRPO 与 REINFORCE++ 归一化对照（组内中心化 vs 全批白化，常数分母 vs 长度归一）、DAPO clip-higher + 动态组过滤 + 全局 token 平均、GSPO 序列级几何平均重要性比（先长度归一再取指数）、CISPO 停梯度裁剪权重与 K3 KL 估计，以及从 DPO 题族收编的 DPO 损失解析反向（dL/dΔ=-βσ(-x)/B，掩码位置梯度严格为零）。每题给定序列级 logprob / 优势 / 隐藏态等预计算量，log-sigmoid 与 log-softmax 均要求数值稳定，逐题独立 oracle 对拍；α=0、β=0、z=z_ref、KL 命中等退化情形有专项断言。
description_en: 21 training objectives and advantage estimation operators from the RLHF/alignment pipeline: the DPO direct preference optimization loss (policy and reference-policy log ratios assembled into a Bradley-Terry logistic objective), the PPO/GRPO clipped surrogate objective (min+clip trust region over the probability ratio exp(Δlogprob)), the Bradley-Terry reward model loss (last valid token pooling + value-head scoring + pairwise ranking), and Label Smoothing cross-entropy (soft labels split into an NLL term and a uniform-distribution KL regularization term); the extended batch includes GAE generalized advantage estimation (backward recursion for advantages/returns), PPO value function clipping (max-of-squares of old/new value estimates and returns), GRPO intra-group standardized advantages (per-group mean and biased standard deviation), the KTO prospect-theory loss (desirable/undesirable value relative to the reference point), the SimPO length-normalized preference loss (average log probability as reward + target margin), and a PPO adaptive KL coefficient controller (smooth adjustment after clipping the proportional error). The follow-up batch adds 11 more: the ORPO reference-free odds-ratio loss (SFT term + λ·odds term, length-normalized before a stable log-odds), the IPO squared target-margin loss (Δ pulled toward 1/(2β), no β scaling), cDPO symmetric label-noise smoothing (ε=0 recovers DPO), GKD generalized-JSD on-policy distillation (temperature scaling + probability-space mixture + hard-label CE on unscaled logits), MiniLM per-head attention KL plus relation-representation MSE distillation, the RLOO leave-one-out baseline advantage (denominator G-1, zero-sum per group), a Dr. GRPO vs REINFORCE++ normalization contrast (group-centered vs batch-whitened, constant denominator vs length-normalized), DAPO clip-higher + dynamic group filtering + global token averaging, the GSPO sequence-level geometric-mean importance ratio (length-normalize before exponentiation), CISPO stop-gradient clipped weights with the K3 KL estimator, and the DPO analytic backward pass adopted from the DPO problem family (dL/dΔ=-βσ(-x)/B, exactly zero gradient at masked positions). Each problem provides precomputed quantities such as sequence-level logprob / advantages / hidden states, requires numerically stable log-sigmoid and log-softmax, and is cross-checked against an independent oracle per problem; degenerate cases such as α=0, β=0, z=z_ref, and KL hitting the bound have dedicated assertions.

name: 推测解码合集
description: 对齐 SpeculativeDecodingPapers 里带源码链接的算法：Medusa 多头候选树的 typical acceptance 验证、Sequoia 单位置多分支采样与验证（Algorithm 2，残差分布动态收缩）、Sequoia 最优草稿树期望 token 数 DP（Algorithm 1，位置接受假设下的二维 T[n,b]）、Typical Acceptance 单序列逐 token 阈值接受、Lookahead 解码的 Jacobi n-gram 候选池匹配-回退-自学习、以及 REST/Suffix Decoding 的最长后缀检索草稿。随机性（采样、接受硬币、回退）一律以显式均匀数入参注入、树形/datastore 等结构作显式入参，保证判题确定；每题另设独立纯 Python oracle（CDF 反查 / 暴力枚举树 / 候选元组取最优）逐题对拍。
description_en: Algorithms with source links in SpeculativeDecodingPapers: Medusa multi-head candidate tree typical acceptance verification, Sequoia single-position multi-branch sampling and verification (Algorithm 2, residual distribution dynamically shrinking), Sequoia optimal draft tree expected token count DP (Algorithm 1, the two-dimensional T[n,b] under the positional acceptance assumption), Typical Acceptance single-sequence per-token threshold acceptance, Lookahead decoding's Jacobi n-gram candidate pool match-fallback-self-learning, and REST/Suffix Decoding longest-suffix retrieval drafting. Randomness (sampling, acceptance coins, fallback) is always injected as explicit uniform numbers, and structures such as trees and the datastore are explicit inputs, ensuring deterministic judging; each problem additionally has an independent pure-Python oracle (CDF inverse lookup / brute-force tree enumeration / best-of candidate tuples) for cross-checking.

name: 参数高效微调合集
description: 冻结主干、只训旁路小模块的 PEFT 谱系：LoRA 前向（缩放 s=alpha/r 的低秩旁路）与权重合并（W'=W0+s·BA 后单次 matmul）、IA³ 逐输出神经元缩放的 re-parameterization、Adapter 瓶颈降维-ReLU-升维-残差、DoRA 把权重按幅值×方向拆解后只对方向做低秩更新，以及 LoRA 可训练参数量与压缩比账（full=Σ d_in·d_out vs lora=Σ r·(d_in+d_out)）。续批 6 题覆盖共享参数向量索引分配（UniLoRA）、稀疏标量+LoRA 混合（SuperTuning/Supra）、冻结随机基+可训系数（RandLora）、量化基座交替 SVD 初始化（LoftQ）、离散傅里叶基系数重建（FourierFT）、多任务共享池拼接（MultiTaskPromptTuning），均按纯函数/纯张量重建 ΔW 范式、独立 oracle 与退化断言对拍。公式全部回源核实到 Hu(2106.09685)/Liu(2205.05638)/Houlsby(1902.00751)/Liu(2402.09353) 及对应新方法原论文，采用 nn.Linear 行向量惯例 y=x·Wᵀ；为判题确定性去掉 Dropout，每题另设独立 oracle（合并矩阵重算 / 逐元素三重循环 / 逐样本列向量 / 逐行范数）与 α=0、λ=1、m=‖V‖ 等退化不变量专项断言，CPU float32 对拍。本批再补 3 题：HRA 的 Householder 反射乘积（紧凑 WY 表示 H=I−VTVᵀ，GS 分支 T=2I、非 GS 分支由 VᵀV 上三角解出，合并 W0H）、RoAD 的输出侧分组二维旋转（road_1/2/4 的参数排布、x·first+rotate_half(x)·second 与矩阵形式一致）、DeLoRA 的有界低秩更新（按 A 行范数与 B 列范数归一化逐分量缩放、按输入通道乘冻结 w_norm、正交因子下 ‖ΔW‖_F=λ/√r），逐行对齐 huggingface/peft 各 tuner 源码，另设独立 oracle（顺序反射乘积 / 分块填矩阵 / 纯 Python 范数循环）与随机对拍。本批再补 2 题：GLoRA 的多适配器合并与精确逆解（W′=W0+Σ_i(W0⊙A_i+B_i)、b′=b0+Σ_i(b0⊙D_i+E_i+W0C_i)，每一项都乘原始 W0 以避免顺序复合；逆解 W0=(W′−ΣB)/(1+ΣA)、b0=(b′−ΣE−ΣW0C)/(1+ΣD) 且 C 项用恢复后的 W0）、WaveFT 的稀疏频谱增量权重（种子化 randperm 选坐标 + 行优先 scatter + scaling，覆盖 get_delta_weight 的 direct 路径），逐行对齐 peft 的 tuners/glora.py 与 tuners/waveft.py，另设独立 oracle 与退化断言。本批再补 3 题：C3A 的块循环卷积增量（核 (d_out//bs, d_in//bs, bs)，块内 delta[m·bs+i, n·bs+j]=kernel[m,n,(j-i)//bs 取模]/d_in，整块每行都是核的循环右移，归一化分母是 d_in 而非 block size）、VB-LoRA 的向量库选择（每侧 logits 取 topk 后**只在选中分数上 softmax**、加权求和库行，A 按 tile 主序展平、B 先 transpose(1,2) 再展平，delta=B@A 且没有 alpha/r 缩放；并列分数钉成「值降序、下标升序」的稳定口径以保证跨后端可复现）、BOFT 的蝴蝶分解正交变换（逐块 Cayley 右解 Q=(I+S)⁻¹(I−S)、每级 blockdiag 再按 P_i 共轭、级间 M=M_(F-1)…M_0，M 作用在权重输入侧 W'=(M@W0ᵀ)ᵀ⊙s，置换按「段长 H·2ⁱ、组大小 H/2、偶数组在前」）。逐行对齐 peft 的 tuners/c3a、tuners/vblora 与 tuners/boft 源码，另设独立 oracle（逐块逐元素循环取模 / numpy 稳定 argsort 选择 / 显式置换阵共轭连乘），并用真实 peft 复核（BOFT 多级需 monkeypatch FastBlockDiag），对 arXiv:2407.19342、2405.15179、2311.06243 逐一回源。
description_en: The PEFT spectrum of freezing the backbone and training only small side modules: LoRA forward (a low-rank side path scaled by s=alpha/r) and weight merging (a single matmul after W'=W0+s·BA), IA³ per-output-neuron scaling re-parameterization, Adapter bottleneck down-projection–ReLU–up-projection–residual, DoRA decomposing the weight into magnitude×direction and applying the low-rank update only to the direction, plus the LoRA trainable parameter count and compression ratio ledger (full=Σ d_in·d_out vs lora=Σ r·(d_in+d_out)). A second batch of 6 problems covers shared-parameter vector index assignment (UniLoRA), sparse-scalar + LoRA mixing (SuperTuning/Supra), frozen random bases with trainable coefficients (RandLora), quantized-base alternating SVD initialization (LoftQ), discrete Fourier basis coefficient reconstruction (FourierFT), and multi-task shared-pool concatenation (MultiTaskPromptTuning), all following the pure-function / pure-tensor ΔW reconstruction paradigm with independent oracles and degeneracy assertions. All formulas are traced back and verified against the original papers Hu(2106.09685)/Liu(2205.05638)/Houlsby(1902.00751)/Liu(2402.09353) and the corresponding newer methods, using the nn.Linear row-vector convention y=x·Wᵀ; Dropout is removed for judging determinism, each problem additionally has an independent oracle (merged-matrix recomputation / element-wise triple loop / per-sample column vector / per-row norm) plus dedicated assertions on degenerate invariants such as α=0, λ=1, m=‖V‖, with CPU float32 cross-checking. This batch adds 3 more: HRA's Householder reflection product (compact WY form H=I−VTVᵀ, with T=2I on the GS branch and T solved from the upper triangle of VᵀV otherwise, merged as W0H), RoAD's grouped 2-D rotations on the layer output (parameter layouts for road_1/2/4, with x·first+rotate_half(x)·second matching the matrix form), and DeLoRA's bounded low-rank update (per-component scaling by A's row norms and B's column norms, a frozen per-input-channel w_norm, and ‖ΔW‖_F=λ/√r for orthonormal factors), each aligned line-by-line with the corresponding huggingface/peft tuner source and backed by independent oracles (sequential reflection product / block-filled matrix / pure-Python norm loop) plus random cross-checks. This batch adds 2 more: GLoRA's multi-adapter merge with exact unmerge (W′=W0+Σ_i(W0⊙A_i+B_i) and b′=b0+Σ_i(b0⊙D_i+E_i+W0C_i), where every term multiplies the original W0 so adapters never compound; the inverse is W0=(W′−ΣB)/(1+ΣA) and b0=(b′−ΣE−ΣW0C)/(1+ΣD) with the C term using the recovered W0), and WaveFT's sparse spectrum delta weights (seeded randperm position selection + row-major scatter + scaling, covering the direct path of get_delta_weight), aligned line-by-line with peft's tuners/glora.py and tuners/waveft.py, each with an independent oracle and degeneracy assertions. This batch adds 3 more: C3A's block-circulant delta (kernel of shape (d_out//bs, d_in//bs, bs), with delta[m*bs+i, n*bs+j] = kernel[m, n, (j-i) mod bs] / d_in so every row of a block is a cyclic shift of the kernel and the normalization denominator is d_in rather than the block size), VB-LoRA's vector-bank selection (take the topk logits per vector and **softmax over the selected scores only**, then weight-sum bank rows; A is flattened tile-major while B is transposed before flattening, delta = B @ A with no alpha/r scaling, and tied scores are pinned to 'value descending, index ascending' so it is reproducible across backends), and BOFT's butterfly-factorized orthogonal transform (per-block Cayley right solve Q=(I+S)^-1(I-S), each stage block-diagonalized then conjugated by P_i, stages multiplied as M = M_(F-1)...M_0, and M acts on the input side via W' = (M @ W0^T)^T * s with the permutation given by 'segment length H*2^i, group size H/2, even groups first'). Aligned line-by-line with peft's tuners/c3a, tuners/vblora and tuners/boft sources, each backed by an independent oracle (per-block per-element modular loop / numpy stable-argsort selection / explicit permutation-matrix conjugation), and cross-checked against the real library (BOFT's multi-stage path requires monkeypatching FastBlockDiag); arXiv:2407.19342, 2405.15179 and 2311.06243 were each verified at the source.

name: 扩散模型合集
description: 扩散生成模型的采样与调度基建：正弦时间步嵌入（前半 sin、后半 cos、freq=10000^(-i/half)）、线性/余弦两种噪声调度输出 ᾱ 序列（Nichol-Dhariwal cosine + clip(0,0.999)）、DDPM 前向一步加噪 q(x_t|x_0)=√ᾱ_t·x_0+√(1-ᾱ_t)·ε、DDPM 反向后验单步 p(x_{t-1}|x_t,x_0)（含 tilde-beta 方差、z=0 退化为均值）、σ_t=0 的 DDIM 确定性去噪单步（ᾱ_prev=ᾱ_t 恒等、=1 回 x0 两个退化探针）与无分类器引导 ε_u+w(ε_c-ε_u)（w=0→uncond、w=1→cond）。公式全部回源核实到 Ho(2006.11239)/Nichol-Dhariwal(2102.09672)/Song(2010.02502)/Ho-Salimans(2207.12598) 原论文；噪声 ε/z 均作显式入参以保证 CPU float32 判题确定性，每题另设独立 oracle（math 逐频率/逐 t 累乘/逐元素双循环/等价式重算）与退化不变量专项断言。续批 8 题把采样侧补全：ε/x₀/v description_en: Sampling and scheduling infrastructure for diffusion generative models: sinusoidal timestep embedding (first half sin, second half cos, freq=10000^(-i/half)), linear and cosine noise schedules outputting the ᾱ sequence (Nichol-Dhariwal cosine + clip(0,0.999)), one-step DDPM forward noising q(x_t|x_0)=√ᾱ_t·x_0+√(1-ᾱ_t)·ε, the DDPM reverse posterior single step p(x_{t-1}|x_t,x_0) (with tilde-beta variance, degenerating to the mean when z=0), the DDIM deterministic denoising single step with σ_t=0 (two degenerate probes: ᾱ_prev=ᾱ_t identity, and =1 returning to x0) and classifier-free guidance ε_u+w(ε_c-ε_u) (w=0→uncond, w=1→cond). All formulas are traced back and verified against the original papers Ho(2006.11239)/Nichol-Dhariwal(2102.09672)/Song(2010.02502)/Ho-Salimans(2207.12598); the noise ε/z are explicit inputs to guarantee CPU float32 judging determinism, and each problem additionally has an independent oracle (math per-frequency / per-t cumulative product / element-wise double loop / equivalent-formula recomputation) plus dedicated assertions on degenerate invariants. This batch of 8 completes the sampling side: converting between the ε/x0/v targets (the orthogonal-rotation view of (x0,ε)→(x_t,v) plus both endpoint singularities), the DPM-Solver++(2M) second-order update (λ=log(α/σ) exponential integrator, order=1 bitwise equivalent to the DDIM closed form, plus the second-order difference identity), Euler integration of a Flow Matching / Rectified Flow velocity field (a single step is exact on the straight path), the RF timestep shift (t′=s·t/(1+(s-1)t), i.e. a logit-domain shift, with µ linearly interpolated from the sequence length and shifts composing multiplicatively), zero-terminal-SNR rescaling with log-SNR / rotation-angle parameterization (terminal ᾱ=0, λ=-inf, θ=π/2, explaining why v-prediction is mandatory), CFG std rescaling with the guidance interval (per-sample population std matching, closed interval, φ blending), the SDEdit strength truncation (i=floor(s·(T-1)) and the noising landing point), and the VAE latent shift/scale with per-channel prior whitening (SDXL / SD3 / Flux constant differences and the encode/decode round trip). This batch adds 3 training-side data-pipeline problems: SD3 timestep-sampling density (sigmoid of a normal draw for logit-normal; the 1−u−s(cos²(πu/2)−1+u) transform for mode with mode_scale=1.29), Min-SNR loss weighting (snr=(√ᾱ/√(1−ᾱ))², w=min(snr,γ)/snr, where γ caps the SNR rather than the weight), and aspect-ratio buckets with nearest-bucket assignment (h=√(res²/a) snapped to divisibility with order-preserving dedupe, the cross-multiplied |h·bw−w·bh| metric, ties going to the later bucket, and base_resolutions given as (h,w) but converted to (w,h) for the ratio), all traced back to diffusers training_utils with independent oracles and endpoint/symmetry/monotonicity/dedupe/tie invariants. This batch adds 3 problems covering inversion / inpainting / discrete sampling: the DDIM inversion step (separating the output level `timestep` from the prediction level t=min(timestep−T//N,T−1), the initial-alpha fallback when t<0, an explicit error when the sample branch hits β=0, and returning the clamped x₀), the RePaint resample jump table (descending from the raised point rather than the original one, jump points range(0,N−j), budget n−1, ascents of length exactly j whose count is (n−1)×jump points, and step ratio T//min(T,N)), and entropy-bounded unmasking (temperature annealed by (N−s)/N from t_max, Categorical entropy, the self-excluded ascending prefix-sum rule cum−H≤B, stable tie handling by index, and sampled-vs-random tokens per position), aligned line-by-line with diffusers' DDIMInverseScheduler / RePaintScheduler / EntropyBoundScheduler, each with an independent oracle (element-wise math recomputation / a recursive walk / a pure-Python stable sort) and degeneracy assertions. This batch adds 3 guidance-operator problems (diffusers `guiders/`): APG's adaptive projection (split the difference against the conditional prediction into parallel/orthogonal parts, η scales only the parallel part, a per-sample norm clamp min(1,τ/‖δ‖), and a momentum buffer storing the pre-clamp difference, with η=1 degenerating to bare CFG and η=0 leaving an update orthogonal to the conditional prediction), CFG-Zero*'s zero init and least-squares scale (α=⟨ε_c,ε_u⟩/(‖ε_u‖²+ε), the first k steps emitting all zeros, s=1 returning exactly the conditional branch, and α=0 for orthogonal branches), and TCFG's SVD-truncated projection (project ε_u onto the first right singular direction of [ε_c;ε_u] before extrapolating; the two-row matrix admits a closed-form 2×2 Gram solution, and tied singular values resolve to ε_c's direction by convention), all aligned line-by-line with the diffusers guiders sources, each with an independent oracle and degeneracy assertions. This batch adds 3 more guider problems: PAG's dual-scale guidance (CFG uses the half-open window int(start·N)≤s<int(stop·N) while PAG uses the strict window int(ps·N)<s<int(pe·N); s=1 disables CFG and s_skip=0 disables PAG, with four branches composed by the two switches), MAMBO-G's magnitude-aware guidance (per-sample r=‖c−u‖₂/‖u‖₂ and w′=1+(w−1)exp(−λr), with w′=1 when ‖u‖=0), and FDG's frequency-decoupled guidance (per-level CFG over a Laplacian pyramid from high to low frequencies, with the difference split into parallel/orthogonal parts against the conditional band and reweighted when w_l≠1, plus per-level rescale and per-level windows), all aligned line-by-line with the diffusers guiders sources; FDG's disabled branch reuses the previous level's prediction upstream, which this problem deliberately defines as passing through the current level's conditional band (documented in the notes), each with an independent oracle and degeneracy assertions.This batch adds 13 more problems that connect the "grid → preconditioning → multistep → SDE → few-step" spine of the diffusers samplers, plus three gaps on the guidance, training, and discrete sides: the EulerDiscrete timestep grid (three rounding schemes for linspace/leading/trailing, leading's integer division with steps_offset, trailing's true-division round−1 that can yield N+1 points, np.interp linear interpolation, log_linear ignoring the grid and producing one extra point, the Karras ρ=7 and exponential σ converters mapped back to t by log-space interpolation, and the zero/sigma_min terminal), FlowMatchEuler's dynamic μ shift and shift_terminal stretch (exponential and linear scales are e^μ and μ, static shift equals μ=ln s, the terminal stretch happens before deriving timesteps, and invert_sigmas flips to 1−σ with a terminal of 1), EDM preconditioning's four coefficients (c_in/c_noise at the pre-churn σ, c_skip/c_out at σ̂, v-prediction negating c_out, and the final step's prev downgrade on its own, and a downgraded final step still advancing the counter), the same family's convert_model_output with dynamic thresholding (data/noise formulations' x0/ε branches, flow_prediction using the raw σ, learned variance slicing only epsilon, and the per-sample quantile clamped to [1, sample_max_value]), EulerAncestral's σ_up/σ_down split with ancestral noise injection (the two squares summing to σ_to², dt using σ_down, the final step landing exactly on x0, and upstream's v-prediction branch missing a factor α — copied verbatim and flagged), and LCM's boundary-condition coefficients (c_out lacking a σ_d factor compared with EDM, coefficients driven by timestep×timestep_scaling, σ_d hard-coded to 0.5, prev_timestep taken from the next array entry, and no re-noising on the final step); it also adds APG-Mix's CFG warm-up with orthogonal projection, LTX-2's three-way incremental guidance composition, SEG's query smoothing (square Gaussian blur preserving the mean), D3PM uniform-corruption posterior routing, SD3's σ loss weighting with confidence-aware cross entropy, and bucket-string parsing/validation. Every problem ships an independent oracle (numpy element-wise recomputation or pure-Python scalar expansion) plus degeneracy probes (ρ=1, N=1, shift=0, solver_order=1, final σ=0, t=0).The closing batch of 3 problems for #93: AMUS/MaskGIT top-k remasking (step_idx = N-1-timestep to recover the step, mask_len through the floor -> min(unknown-1) -> max(1) triple clamp, the torch.finfo(dtype).max sentinel applied *before* the log so it suppresses already-known positions, Gumbel noise -log(-log u) with a strict less-than cut-off test, and timestep 0 committing every position at once), AutoGuidance's paired anchor/identity flip (use_original_formulation moves both the anchor from pred_uncond to pred_cond and the identity scale from 1.0 to 0.0; math.isclose degrades to an absolute test against 0.0 - only exactly 0.0 counts as off - while against 1.0 it is relative; guidance_rescale sits outside the if/else so the disabled branch still runs it; the window is int(start*N) <= step < int(stop*N) and pred_uncond may be None when guidance is off), and the Consistency Decoder's schedule plus two-step denoise (betas_for_alpha_bar's cosine/laplace/exp transforms with the max_beta clamp, the cumulative product giving sigma = sqrt(1/abar - 1), c_skip/c_in using the *reciprocal* square root of abar, re-noising with the *next* timestep's sqrt(abar)/sqrt(1-abar), the last step returning x0 directly, coefficients indexed by the timestep value rather than the step counter, and a ValueError for schedules that degenerate to abar <= 0). All three are aligned line-by-line with diffusers v0.42.1 and cross-checked against a verbatim transcription, each with an independent pure-Python oracle and endpoint/flip/degeneracy assertions. The next batch adds 1 problem: the UniPC B(h) predictor-corrector step (the corrector reads the buffer before rotation and the predictor after, so the two sides' 'previous output' is not the same tensor; the predictor pins 0.5 at order_p=2 while the corrector pins it at order_c=1, and since b_i is proportional to 1/B_h the product B_h*rhos is solver_type-independent on the general path, so bh1 vs bh2 moves only the two pinned branches; the predictor solves R[:-1,:-1] whereas the corrector solves the full R and applies its last coefficient to the current output; the factorial increments before the next h_phi_k; at the terminal sigma=0 bh1 yields NaN or +-inf, so the statement demands strictly positive sigma), aligned line-by-line with multistep_uni_c_bh_update / multistep_uni_p_bh_update in diffusers v0.42.1, cross-checked against a verbatim transcription, with an independent pure-Python oracle (hand-written Gaussian elimination for Rhos) and invariant / closed-form-degeneracy assertions. The next batch adds 1 more problem: RePaint's masked blend step and forward undo (the known region never enters the network and is stitched to the unknown region cell by cell under the mask; both the known coefficient and the direction coefficient read the jumped-to alpha_prev instead of alpha_t; sigma = eta*sqrt(var) enters only the unknown branch and only when t>0 and eta>0, while the very same noise tensor is reused unconditionally by the known branch; once prev<0 alpha_prev falls back to the 1.0 hardcoded at construction so the whole expression collapses to mask*orig + (1-mask)*x0_hat; the undo is n per-beta sub-steps whose accumulated coefficient is sqrt(abar_{t+n-1}/abar_{t-1}) rather than sqrt(abar_{t+n}/abar_t); and pushing eta past sqrt((1-abar_t)/(1-abar_t/abar_prev)), which upstream silently turns into NaN, is made an explicit error here), aligned line by line with RePaintScheduler.step / undo_step in diffusers v0.42.1 and cross-checked bit for bit against a verbatim transcription over 4 beta schedules x 13 (T,N) pairs x 3 eta levels x the clip/blend switches (25056 comparisons, zero difference), with an independent pure-Python oracle (x0_hat split into separate coefficients on x and eps, undo evaluated through closed-form weights) plus mask / degeneracy / clamping invariants. The next batch adds 1 more problem: VQ-Diffusion's masked discrete reverse step (under an absorbing mask class, p(x_{t-1}|x_t)=Σ_{x0} q(x_t|x_{t-1})·q(x_{t-1}|x_0)·p(x_0)/q(x_t|x_0) is carried out entirely in log space with logaddexp and no matrix product; b=(1-a-c)/(C-1) is given by definition so that abar+k*bbar+gbar=1 holds identically; the single-step tables have length T while the cumulative ones have length T+1 with a sentinel that is never read; V takes the cumulative index t, U the single-step index t and W the cumulative index t-1, so three indices stay separate; the mask row must be saved before [:, :-1, :] drops it and re-appended verbatim, since it plays the role of q(x_t|x_{t-1}=mask); log 0 is clamped to log(1e-30) rather than -inf and survives as U[k] all the way into the final logits; t=0 is a complete bypass that returns model_output verbatim, so the noise also loses a row - running the formula there would instead hit the sentinel through a negative index; Gumbel uses the double 1e-30 clamp and argmax resolves ties to the lowest class index; and per pixel the class sum of exp(logits) always equals the class sum of exp(model_output) independently of t, which is exactly the normalization upstream verifies against equation (11) of the paper), aligned line by line with VQDiffusionScheduler.step / q_posterior / log_Q_t_transitioning_to_known_class / apply_cumulative_transitions in diffusers v0.42.1 and cross-checked against a verbatim transcription (including upstream's float32 downcast) over 30 (T,C) configurations whose t reaches both 0 and T-1 (zero argmax flips, largest absolute logit difference 6.964e-06), with an independent pure-Python oracle in probability space (explicit transition matrices) plus assertions on the clamp, the mass invariant, tie ordering and shapes. The next batch adds one more: a single commit step of BlockRefinement, where two mutually inequivalent quota regimes coexist inside one step (mask filling eats the remainder-first per-step quantity q_min(t,N-1), uniform corruption eats the cumulative target ceil((t+1)L/N) minus what is already committed — for L=10/N=6 the per-step table's prefix sums [2,4,6,8,9,10] are not the cumulative targets [2,4,5,7,9,10], and they agree only when N divides L); when |S| >= quota the commit set is every above-threshold position rather than a truncation to quota, and quota=0 still takes that branch; masks_remaining is a batch-free global any() that only decides whether to enter the if, rows are still computed separately, and only a maskless whole block empties transfer; the editing_threshold switch means opposite things in the two modes (mask mode requires >0, uniform mode checks only is not None, so 0.0 and negatives enable editing and the set degenerates to committed-with-changed-token); uniform mode's committed is the state before the step and t==0 forces it empty, ranking comes from masked_fill(-inf) plus a double argsort, and transfer must be ANDed with ~committed or committed positions burn quota; the final re-noising is applied on the updated `after` so positions committed this very step are not wiped by random_tokens; every comparison happens after downcasting to float32 (a float64 0.9500000000000001 against threshold 0.95 measurably commits one position less), unselected positions compare as -inf rather than 0, ties are pinned to ascending index order (measured to give the same sets as upstream's torch.topk on 4914 random steps), minimal_topk is a dead parameter read from config and never referenced again, and upstream's descending timesteps array contradicts step treating its argument as a 0-based index. Aligned line by line with BlockRefinementScheduler.step / get_num_transfer_tokens in diffusers v0.42.1 and cross-checked against a verbatim transcription over 1696 configurations spanning both modes and both t=0 and t>=N with zero differences, plus an independent pure-Python oracle (explicit rank and set reasoning, no torch operators) and assertions on the union, the re-noising protection, the asymmetric editing switch, and shapes/types.

name: 稀疏剪枝合集
description: 模型压缩里的剪枝与稀疏存储全家福：全局幅值剪枝（跨整层丢弃绝对值最小的一批权重，Han et al. Deep Compression 1510.00149）、逐行局部幅值剪枝（稀疏预算在每个输出神经元内部独立分配，与全局阀值形成对比）、面向 NVIDIA Ampere Sparse Tensor Core 的 2:4 半结构化剪枝（每连续 4 元素保留 top-2）、Zhu-Gupta 三次渐稀疏率调度 GSL（1710.01878，窗口内 (1-t/T)^3 平滑推稀疏率）、按块 L1 范数全局竞争的块结构剪枝，以及将稠密矩阵行主序编码为 CSR 三数组（indptr/indices/values）。并列、阈值取数与剪除单位均有确定性约定（stable argsort + 固定 tie-break）；每题另设独立纯 Python/torch 逐元素 oracle（结构异于参考解）与 sparsity=0/1、每块全留或全删、全零矩阵退化等专项断言，CPU float32 对拍；另有 7 道进阶题：注意力头重要性打分 + 结构化剪枝（Wanda 2306.11695 的 ||W_h||_F·||X_h||_F 口径）、软阈值 / ISTA 近端迭代（L1 正则的逐坐标收缩步）、剪枝微调的 STE 直通梯度与 WSN 软掩码（Bengio 1308.3432、Kusupati 2002.10509）、MovERec / RigL 动态丢弃-再激活（按 |w| 抖落、按 |grad| 复活，Evci 1911.11134）、SparseGPT 逐列剪枝 + Hessian 逆误差补偿（Frantar & Alistarh 2301.00774）、2:4 元数据（每 4 元素组 4 bit nibble）打包成 Tensor Core 格式、ELL / BSR 多格式转换与 CSR/ELL/BSR 存储字节账。续批三题沿三个正交轴推进：元素级 Wanda（2306.11695，打分 |W|·√(mean_N X²)，逐行 unstructured 与可选 N:M，计数用 int 截断；与前述 sparsity-head-importance 按整头 ||W_h||_F·||X_h||_F 全局剪的粒度互补）、层间预算 OWL（2310.05175，先算每层离群元素占比、归一化到 [0,2λ] 后减均值再加 (1-sparsity) 得密度，逐层稀疏率由此可升可降、非正值压到 0.01、各层离群比全等时报错）、行内迭代 TRIM（2505.16743，按裁剪前后逐行余弦构造 delta、沿学习率网格贪心取重建误差最小者、并把行稀疏率均值钉回目标，可禁用负学习率）。
description_en: A full set of pruning and sparse storage techniques in model compression: global magnitude pruning (drop the lowest-absolute-value weights across the whole layer, Han et al. Deep Compression 1510.00149), per-row local magnitude pruning (the sparsity budget is allocated independently inside each output neuron, contrasting with a global threshold), 2:4 semi-structured pruning for NVIDIA Ampere Sparse Tensor Cores (keep the top-2 of every consecutive 4 elements), the Zhu-Gupta cubic sparsity schedule GSL (1710.01878, smoothly pushing the sparsity ratio via (1-t/T)^3 within a window), block-structured pruning competing globally by block L1 norm, and encoding a dense matrix row-major into the three CSR arrays (indptr/indices/values). Tie-breaking, threshold selection, and pruning units all have deterministic conventions (stable argsort + fixed tie-break); each problem additionally has an independent pure-Python/torch element-wise oracle (structurally different from the reference solution) plus dedicated assertions for sparsity=0/1, keep-all or drop-all per block, and all-zero matrix degeneracy, with CPU float32 cross-checking. The batch also adds 7 advanced items: attention-head importance scoring + structured pruning (the ||W_h||_F*||X_h||_F criterion of Wanda 2306.11695), soft-thresholding / ISTA proximal iteration (the per-coordinate shrinkage step of L1 regularisation), STE straight-through gradients and WSN soft masks for pruning fine-tuning (Bengio 1308.3432, Kusupati 2002.10509), MovERec / RigL dynamic drop-grow reactivation (drop by |w|, regrow by |grad|, Evci 1911.11134), SparseGPT column-wise pruning with Hessian-inverse error compensation (Frantar & Alistarh 2301.00774), 2:4 metadata (a 4-bit nibble per group of 4) packing into the Tensor Core format, and ELL / BSR multi-format conversion with CSR/ELL/BSR storage byte accounting. The follow-up advances along three orthogonal axes: element-wise Wanda (2306.11695, score |W|*sqrt(mean over N of X^2), per-row unstructured pruning plus optional N:M, counts truncated rather than rounded; complementary in granularity to the whole-head global ||W_h||_F*||X_h||_F pruning of sparsity-head-importance above), inter-layer budget allocation OWL (2310.05175: per-layer outlier-element ratio, normalised into [0, 2*lambda], minus its mean plus (1-sparsity) gives the density, so per-layer sparsities move both up and down, non-positive values are floored at 0.01, and identical outlier ratios across layers raise an error), and intra-row iterative feedback TRIM (2505.16743: a delta built from the per-row cosine between the unpruned and pruned weights, a greedy learning-rate grid search minimising the reconstruction error, and the row-sparsity mean pinned back to the target, with an option to forbid negative learning rates).

name: 多模态合集
description: 视觉-语言模型的几何重排与对比训练基建：ViT patchify（(B,C,H,W)→(B,N,C·p²)、块行优先且 token 内按通道-行-列，与 unpatchify 互逆）、Swin window partition（(B,H,W,C) 切成不重叠窗口批、窗内保留二维布局）、Qwen2-VL PatchMerger 的 2×2 空间合并（相邻四 patch 按左上-右上-左下-右下拼接、token 数↓4 通道↑4，剥离带权重 Linear）、CLIP 对称 InfoNCE 对比损失（图像↔文本双向行交叉熵取半均、对角为正对、可学温度 logit_scale）、SigLIP 逐对 sigmoid 对比损失（z=scale·sim+bias、±1 标签、分母取 batch 大小 B、无 softmax 全局归一）与 Qwen2-VL 风格 M-RoPE 位置编号（三轴 (t,h,w)、文本三轴同步递增、图像块内 t 恒定、h/w 按行列展开、块后 running+=max(h,w)）。前三题为无损双射重排（测试用逆操作还原校验），损失题为 CPU float32 标量；每题另设独立纯 Python 逐元素/逐对 oracle 与退化不变量专项断言；多模态机制公式回源核实到 Dosovitskiy(2010.11929)/Liu(2111.03861)/Radford(2103.00020)/Zhai(2303.15343)/Bai(2409.12191)。续批覆盖 HF Qwen2-VL smart_resize 尺寸与槽位预算、CLIP 中心裁剪及归一化子链、保留前缀的二维位置嵌入双三次重采样、末帧补齐与合并友好的视频 patch 顺序、LLaVA 式单图占位展开和 batch 整理、带视觉掩码扩展的 Perceiver latent 压缩子层，以及 Flamingo 最近媒体可见性和标量 tanh 门控注意力。第二续批把口径推到提示编码与 token 选择：Segment Anything 的稀疏提示嵌入（长边缩放的逐轴因子、像素中心 +0.5、`-1` 标签先清零再写 `not_a_point_embed`、框角取 `point_embeddings[2..3]`）与随机高斯稠密位置网格、SAM 的 `calculate_stability_score`（`thr±offset` 的嵌套 int16/int32 计数比）和按 iou 分数加提示点数惩罚选最优 mask 的规则、FastV 的末层末行注意力按头均值 top-k 剪枝（位置编号保留被删 token 的间隙）、LLaVA-PruMerge 的 CLS 注意力 top-k 选择加 L2 归一余弦最近邻聚类合并（softmax 后乘 `C**-0.5`、簇内不再归一），以及 FLUX 的轴分离 2D RoPE（每轴独立 `get_1d_rotary_pos_embed` + `repeat_interleave_real`、cos/sin 按轴拼接、成对旋转走 `use_real_unbind_dim=-1`）。机制逐行回源到 Kirillov(2304.02643)、Yang(2403.06764)、Lin(2403.15388) 与 FLUX.1 在 HuggingFace diffusers 的 `FluxPosEmbed` 实现。均为显式输入的 CPU 确定性算法；不包含真实图像解码/resize、完整 Q-Former 或完整视觉语言模型。
description_en: Geometric rearrangement and contrastive training infrastructure for vision-language models: ViT patchify ((B,C,H,W)→(B,N,C·p²), blocks in row-major order and channel-row-column within a token, mutually inverse with unpatchify), Swin window partition ((B,H,W,C) split into a batch of non-overlapping windows, preserving the 2D layout inside each window), Qwen2-VL PatchMerger 2×2 spatial merging (four adjacent patches concatenated as top-left, top-right, bottom-left, bottom-right, token count ↓4 and channels ↑4, with the weighted Linear stripped out), the CLIP symmetric InfoNCE contrastive loss (image↔text bidirectional row cross-entropy, halved average, diagonal as positive pairs, learnable temperature logit_scale), the SigLIP pairwise sigmoid contrastive loss (z=scale·sim+bias, ±1 labels, denominator equal to batch size B, no softmax global normalization), and Qwen2-VL-style M-RoPE position numbering (three axes (t,h,w), all three axes incrementing in sync for text, constant t within image blocks, h/w expanded by rows and columns, running+=max(h,w) after each block). The first three problems are lossless bijective rearrangements (tests verify by restoring with the inverse operation), and the loss problems produce CPU float32 scalars; each problem additionally has an independent pure-Python element-wise/pairwise oracle and dedicated assertions on degenerate invariants; the multimodal mechanism formulas are traced back and verified against Dosovitskiy(2010.11929)/Liu(2111.03861)/Radford(2103.00020)/Zhai(2303.15343)/Bai(2409.12191). The follow-up adds HF Qwen2-VL smart-resize dimensions and visual-slot budgets, the CLIP center-crop and normalization subchain, prefix-preserving bicubic position-embedding resampling, last-frame padding and merge-friendly video patch ordering, LLaVA-style single-image placeholder expansion and batch assembly, a Perceiver latent-attention sublayer extended with visual masks, and Flamingo immediate-media visibility with scalar tanh-gated attention. The second follow-up moves to prompt encoding and token selection: Segment Anything sparse-prompt embedding (per-axis scale factors from the longest-side resize, the +0.5 pixel-centre offset, label `-1` rows being zeroed before `not_a_point_embed` is written, box corners taking `point_embeddings[2..3]`) together with the random-Gaussian dense positional grid, SAM's `calculate_stability_score` (the nested int16/int32 count ratio of the `thr±offset` masks) and its best-mask pick that adds a prompt-count penalty to the iou scores, FastV's last-layer last-row per-head-mean top-k pruning (position ids keep the gaps left by dropped tokens), LLaVA-PruMerge's CLS-attention top-k selection plus L2-normalised cosine nearest-neighbour cluster merging (softmax then scaled by `C**-0.5`, with no renormalisation inside a cluster), and FLUX's axis-separated 2D RoPE (one `get_1d_rotary_pos_embed` per axis with `repeat_interleave_real`, cos/sin concatenated along the axis dimension, paired rotation via `use_real_unbind_dim=-1`). The mechanisms are traced line by line to Kirillov(2304.02643), Yang(2403.06764), Lin(2403.15388) and the FLUX.1 `FluxPosEmbed` implementation in HuggingFace diffusers. These are deterministic CPU algorithms with explicit inputs, not image decoding/resizing, a complete Q-Former, or a full vision-language model.

name: 语音前端合集
description: 语音模型前端（Whisper / HuBERT / 声学模型）的确定性 DSP 流水线，全部按参考实现逐元素对拍：预加重与分帧加窗、STFT 幅度谱（n_fft / hop / center 反射填充）、Mel 滤波器组与 log-mel（HTK vs Slaney 刻度差异）、MFCC（正交 DCT-II + lifter + CMVN）、整数比多相重采样（windowed-sinc 核设计、相位对齐与增益归一）。与「多模态合集」的音频结构题分工：本合集只收纯信号处理，凡涉及 mel→卷积→audio token 的模型结构一律归多模态。
description_en: The deterministic DSP pipeline in front of speech models (Whisper / HuBERT / acoustic models), every problem compared elementwise against the reference implementation: pre-emphasis with framing and windowing, STFT magnitude (n_fft / hop / center reflect padding), mel filterbanks and log-mel (the HTK vs Slaney scale difference), MFCC via an orthonormal DCT-II with lifter and CMVN, and integer-ratio polyphase resampling (windowed-sinc design, phase alignment, gain normalisation). Split from the Multimodal collection's audio-structure problems: this collection is pure signal processing, anything that goes mel -> strided conv -> audio tokens belongs to Multimodal.

name: 向量检索合集
description: 近似最近邻与 RAG 检索基建的确定性核心子过程：IVF 粗量化器分配（逐向量取平方欧氏最近的粗中心、并列取小下标，Jégou TPAMI 2011 的 coarse quantizer）、乘积量化编码（D 维切成 m 段各 d=D/m 维、逐段在第 j 套子码本独立取最近码字、得 (n,m) 子码，Faiss IndexPQ）、倒数排名融合 RRF（只用 1-based 名次、score(d)=Σ 1/(k+rank) 且 k=60、0 表缺席、降序并列按文档下标升序，Cormack SIGIR 2009）、最大边际相关 MMR 重排（λ·cos(d,q)-(1-λ)·max_{s∈S}cos(d,s) 贪心 k 步、余弦、零范数记 0、λ=1 退化纯相关、λ=0 纯多样，Carbonell SIGIR 1998）、HNSW 单层贪心搜索（从入口沿边跳到更近邻居直至局部最优、ef=1、严格下降必收敛、可卡次优点，Malkov 1603.09320）与 RAG 重叠滑窗分块（步长=chunk_size-overlap、起点<num_tokens 即成块、越界填 -1、固定宽度矩阵，LangChain chunk_overlap）。分配/编码/重排类走 int64 索引输出、HNSW 返 0 维标量、分块返下标矩阵；每题独立纯 Python 逐元素/逐对/逐轮 oracle（与广播或矩阵化参考解结构不同、数值等价）+ 并列取小/精确重建/λ 退化/贪心卡局部最优/覆盖不丢 token 等专项断言；检索算法公式与哨兵约定一律回源核实。
description_en: The deterministic core subroutines of approximate nearest neighbor and RAG retrieval infrastructure: IVF coarse quantizer assignment (nearest coarse center by squared Euclidean distance per vector, smallest index on ties — the coarse quantizer of Jégou TPAMI 2011), product quantization encoding (D dimensions split into m segments of d=D/m dimensions each, the nearest codeword selected independently per segment from the j-th sub-codebook, yielding (n,m) sub-codes, Faiss IndexPQ), reciprocal rank fusion RRF (using only 1-based ranks, score(d)=Σ 1/(k+rank) with k=60, 0 meaning absent, descending with ties broken by ascending document index, Cormack SIGIR 2009), maximal marginal relevance MMR reranking (λ·cos(d,q)-(1-λ)·max_{s∈S}cos(d,s) greedy for k steps, cosine, zero norm recorded as 0, λ=1 degenerating to pure relevance and λ=0 to pure diversity, Carbonell SIGIR 1998), HNSW single-layer greedy search (hop from the entry point along edges to nearer neighbors until a local optimum, ef=1, strictly descending so convergence is guaranteed, can get stuck at a suboptimal point, Malkov 1603.09320), and RAG overlapping sliding-window chunking (stride=chunk_size-overlap, a chunk forms as soon as the start < num_tokens, out-of-range filled with -1, fixed-width matrix, LangChain chunk_overlap). Assignment/encoding/reranking problems output int64 indices, HNSW returns a 0-dimensional scalar, and chunking returns an index matrix; each problem has an independent pure-Python element-wise/pairwise/per-round oracle (structurally different from the broadcast or matrix-based reference solution but numerically equivalent) plus dedicated assertions on smallest-index tie-breaking / exact reconstruction / λ degeneracy / greedy search sticking at a local optimum / coverage without dropping tokens; retrieval algorithm formulas and sentinel conventions are all traced back and verified.

name: LLM 评测指标合集
description: 训练后评估与数据卫生审计的确定性核心计算：困惑度、token 准确率、BLEU/ROUGE、pass@k、nDCG@k、few-shot 预算截断、跨集合污染检测。全部按论文原始定义手写实现，判题环境没有 nltk/rouge_score/sacrebleu/sklearn，靠独立纯 Python oracle 与退化不变量对拍。
description_en: The deterministic core of post-training evaluation and data-hygiene auditing: perplexity, token accuracy, BLEU/ROUGE, pass@k, nDCG@k, few-shot budget truncation and cross-corpus contamination detection. Everything is hand-written from the original paper definitions - the judge environment has no nltk, rouge_score, sacrebleu or sklearn - and is checked against an independent pure-Python oracle plus degenerate invariants.

name: RL 基建合集
description: 大模型强化学习训练栈的调度与数据流侧：优先经验回放与重要性采样权重、rollout 跨 rank 重分片与 padding-free 打包、actor/critic/ref 多模型 colocate 的显存与阶段时间线、奖励归一化的批统计管道、异步生成队列与陈旧度、多段 episode 拼装与截断 bootstrap。与「对齐与训练目标合集」的损失/优势公式明确分工：本合集只考系统账，凡需策略真实生成或环境动力学的一律不出题。
description_en: The scheduling and data-flow side of the LLM RL training stack: prioritized experience replay with importance-sampling weights, cross-rank rollout re-sharding and padding-free packing, actor/critic/reference colocation memory and phase timelines, the reward-normalisation batch-statistics pipeline, asynchronous generation queues with staleness accounting, and multi-segment episode assembly with truncated-bootstrap handling. Deliberately split from the Alignment & Training Objectives collection, which owns the loss and advantage formulas: this collection is systems accounting only - anything requiring a real policy to generate, or an environment to simulate, is out of scope.

name: 智能体系统合集
description: LLM agent 运行时侧的可判部分：把「模型输出了什么」当作显式入参，只考系统对它的编排、解析、调度与预算决策。首批覆盖 ReAct 循环状态机（解析 Action / 执行工具 / 四种终止条件 / 死循环护栏）、工具调用参数的 JSON Schema 校验与归一（必填、类型兜底、枚举、默认值、多余字段）、任务 DAG 的拓扑执行与加权关键路径（小顶堆定序、并行波次、工期下界）、上下文窗口的优先级压缩（钉住片段、贪心装填、时间序还原）。红线：凡需模型真实生成或判断的一律不出题。
description_en: The judgeable half of the LLM agent runtime: what the model emitted is taken as an explicit input, and only the system's orchestration, parsing, scheduling and budgeting decisions are graded. The first batch covers the ReAct loop state machine (Action parsing, tool execution, four termination sources, repeat guard), JSON-Schema validation and normalisation of tool-call arguments (required fields, type repair, enums, defaults, extra keys), task-DAG topological execution with a weighted critical path (min-heap ordering, parallel waves, makespan bound), and priority-based context-window compaction (pinned segments, greedy packing, chronological reassembly). Red line: anything requiring the model to actually generate or decide is out of scope.

name: 视觉检测合集
description: 检测/分割流水线里可确定性判题的基础算子与账本：anchor 生成与 IoU 阈值匹配（多尺度网格、宽高比/尺度组合、按 IoU 取最大 GT、正负样本与忽略区，SSD 1512.02325 / RetinaNet 1708.02002）、FCOS center-ness 与多尺度层分配（无锚框逐位置回归、中心度 sqrt(min(l,r)/max(l,r)·min(t,b)/max(t,b))、按 (l,r,t,b) 最大值落层与尺度范围夹取，Tian 1904.01355）、WBF 加权框融合（按置信度降序簇内加权平均坐标与分数、坐标×分数加权、簇保留阈值，Solovyev 1910.13302）、mAP 三种插值口径（11-point / all-point / COCO 101-point 召回栅格、逐类逐 IoU 阈值取精度均值、IoU 网格与无检出退化，Everingham VOC / Lin COCO）、mask 的 COCO RLE 编解码与 mask IoU（列主序 run-length、counts 以 'L'/'Z' 压缩起点奇偶、交集/并集计数，pycocotools 口径）、FPN 自顶向下融合与层尺寸账（1×1 侧接、最近邻上采样相加、P2–P6 输出步长与参数量，Lin 1612.03144）、旋转框 NMS 与交叠面积（旋转矩形多边形裁剪（Sutherland–Hodgman）求交、IoU 排序抑制，mmcv 口径）与可变形采样偏移聚合（双线性采样网格 + 偏移量 + 权重求和，Dai 1703.06211）。几何/索引/计数类输出 int64 或布尔，坐标与分数走 float 容差；每题独立纯 Python 逐框/逐像素/逐位置 oracle（与向量化参考解结构不同）+ 退化断言（无 GT、单框、IoU=0/1、空 mask、单层金字塔等）；公式与哨兵约定一律回源核实。
description_en: Deterministic base operators and accounting in detection/segmentation pipelines: anchor generation with IoU-threshold matching (multi-scale grids, aspect-ratio/scale combinations, best-GT assignment by IoU, positive/negative/ignore regions, SSD 1512.02325 / RetinaNet 1708.02002), FCOS center-ness and multi-level assignment (anchor-free per-location regression, center-ness sqrt(min(l,r)/max(l,r)·min(t,b)/max(t,b)), level selection by max(l,r,t,b) with scale-range clamping, Tian 1904.01355), weighted box fusion WBF (descending-confidence clusters, confidence-weighted coordinate averaging, cluster keep threshold, Solovyev 1910.13302), three mAP interpolation conventions (11-point / all-point / COCO 101-point recall grids, per-class per-IoU-threshold precision averaging, IoU grid and empty-detection degeneracy, Everingham VOC / Lin COCO), COCO RLE mask codec and mask IoU (column-major run lengths, 'L'/'Z' compressed counts encoding start parity, intersection/union counting, pycocotools conventions), FPN top-down fusion with level accounting (1×1 lateral, nearest-neighbour upsample add, P2–P6 strides and parameter counts, Lin 1612.03144), rotated-box NMS and overlap area (convex polygon clipping (Sutherland–Hodgman) for intersections, IoU-descending suppression, mmcv conventions) and deformable sampling with offset aggregation (bilinear sampling grid + offsets + weights, Dai 1703.06211). Geometry/index/count outputs are int64 or boolean, coordinates and scores use float tolerances; each problem has an independent pure-Python per-box/per-pixel/per-location oracle (structurally different from the vectorised reference) plus degenerate assertions (no GT, single box, IoU=0/1, empty mask, single pyramid level); every formula and sentinel convention is traced back and verified.

name: 自动微分反向合集
description: 反向传播的逐算子账本，全部与 torch.autograd 对拍：softmax 反向只用输出 y 与上游梯度写成 y∘(dY−Σ(dY·y))、交叉熵反向的 (p−onehot)/有效行数与 label smoothing 混合及 ignore_index 分母、linear/matmul 的 dW 必须折叠所有前导 batch 轴、LayerNorm 的 dX 双减项（ΣdY·γ 与 ΣdY·γ∘x̂）与 RMSNorm 恰好少掉的均值项、BatchNorm 训练态三段式与方差的双重计入、注意力对 Q/K/V 的反向含掩码位零梯度与 GQA 折头求和、FlashAttention 用 O/LSE/dO 免存 n×n 概率的 D=rowsum(dO∘O) 重算、Embedding 反向的重复 id 累加、padding 行清零与 scale_grad_by_freq 摊薄、conv2d 的翻转核 dx 与相关式 dw、池化 max 的 argmax 路由（并列取行主序最前）与 adaptive 窗口的分摊、LSTM 的 (i,f,g,o) 门序、o⊙tanh′(c) 回传与沿时间累加/截断 BPTT 的分段自洽、激活函数逐元素导数与零点次梯度约定（relu 在 0 取 0、gelu 用 erf 精确式）、dropout 的掩码门控与 1/(1−p) 缩放、weight_norm 重参数化里 dg=⟨dW,v̂⟩ 与 dv 的投影消歧，以及把自定义 backward 包进 autograd.Function 再逐元素中心差分的 gradcheck。每题都另写一遍前向作为 oracle 走 torch.autograd.grad（gradcheck 题则以中心差分与解析梯度互验），形状/dtype/哨兵与 ValueError 口径只由 starter docstring 唯一规定；数值示例刻意取可手算的整数或 eps=0，保证判题确定。
description_en: A per-operator ledger of backpropagation, every problem cross-checked against torch.autograd: softmax backward written as y∘(dY−Σ(dY·y)) needing only the output, cross-entropy backward as (p−onehot)/n_valid with label-smoothing mixing and the ignore_index denominator, linear/matmul where dW must fold all leading batch axes, LayerNorm's two subtractions in dX (ΣdY·γ and ΣdY·γ∘x̂) against the mean term RMSNorm drops, BatchNorm training-mode three terms with the variance double counting, attention gradients w.r.t. Q/K/V including zero gradients at masked positions and GQA head folding, FlashAttention recomputing with D=rowsum(dO∘O) so the n×n probabilities are never stored, Embedding backward with duplicate-id accumulation, zeroed padding rows and scale_grad_by_freq dilution, conv2d dx with the flipped kernel versus dw as a cross-correlation, pooling max argmax routing (ties to the row-major first) and adaptive window sharing, LSTM with the (i,f,g,o) gate layout, the o⊙tanh′(c) path and accumulation along time plus truncated-BPTT segment consistency, elementwise activation derivatives with the subgradient convention at zero (relu gives 0 at 0, gelu uses the exact erf form), dropout mask gating with the 1/(1−p) scale, weight_norm reparameterization where dg=⟨dW,v̂⟩ and dv are disambiguated by projection, and a gradcheck that wraps a custom backward in autograd.Function and perturbs every element by central differences. Each problem re-implements the forward as its own oracle and takes torch.autograd.grad (the gradcheck one compares analytic gradients with central differences); shape/dtype/sentinel and ValueError conventions are specified only by the starter docstring, and the numeric examples are deliberately chosen to be hand-computable integers or eps=0 for determinism.

name: 数值稳定合集
description: 浮点与归约的账本，全部在 CPU 上以 float64 口径可手算、可对拍：补偿求和里 naive/kahan/kahan_babuska/pairwise 四种模式在 [1e16,1,-1e16,1] 上给出不同的整数（只有 Babuska 保住的 2 就是真值），一旦出现非有限值就全体退化为顺序累加；Welford 流式均值方差用逐元素 d=v-mean 的两步更新，跟 E[x²]−mean² 的求和式在偏置 1e9 的四连号上一个是 5/3 一个恰好是 0.0，空 chunk 与 n=1 各有明确哨兵；跳 NaN 的 sum/mean/max/min 把分母换成有效个数而不是段长，全 NaN 段只有 sum 给 0.0，而 ±inf 是合法数值要照常参与比较；bf16 舍入在整数位模式上做 rne/rz/rna（加 0x7FFF+奇偶、加 0x8000、直接截高 16 位），四个连续 tie 展示 ties-to-even 的锯齿，NaN 与溢出走旁路；FP8-E5M2 的分块量化先用 absmax 定 2^e 尺度（frexp 取指数）再在正规与次正规网格上取最近格点、同距取偶数步长 2^-16，尺度自适应使 block=1 时次正规区反而不可达；随机舍入利用 bf16 格点在「高 16 位整数空间」均匀的性质，把 r=(u32&0xFFFF)/65536 用作向上取的概率，sr 无偏、fwd 偏向零、bwd 远离零，随机数由入参提供以保证判题确定；分块 online softmax 用 m_s 与 M 之差重标定每段的 l 与 exp，合并出与整行一次算完全一致的 probs 与 LSE，并按约定处理 +inf 行（1/k 均分）、全 -inf 行（probs 为 NaN、LSE 为 -inf）与 NaN 行；安全 p 范数先把每段除以段内最大幅值再求幂和，因为 torch.linalg.norm 自己对 [3e154,4e154] 给 inf、对 [3e-200,4e-200] 给 0.0，p=inf 恰好就是缩放因子本身。每题的 oracle 都在结构上独立于参考解（math.fsum、两遍法、纯 Python 分段归约、位模式 struct、Decimal 高精度幂、格点枚举加 bisect、torch 整行一次算），形状/dtype/哨兵与 ValueError 口径只由 starter docstring 唯一规定，示例数值刻意取可在纸面上复核的整数比例或格点值。
description_en: A ledger of floating point and reduction, every case hand-computable and cross-checkable on the CPU under float64 semantics: compensated summation compares naive/kahan/kahan_babuska/pairwise, which return three different integers on [1e16,1,-1e16,1] (only the 2 that Babuska keeps is the true value), and every mode degrades to sequential accumulation as soon as a non-finite value appears; Welford's streaming mean/variance updates element by element with d=v-mean, which contrasts with the E[x²]-mean² sum-of-squares form that returns exactly 0.0 instead of 5/3 on four consecutive integers offset by 1e9, with sentinels for empty chunks and n=1; a NaN-skipping sum/mean/max/min divides by the count of valid entries rather than the segment length, only sum yields 0.0 on an all-NaN segment, and +-inf stays a legal number that participates in the comparison; bf16 rounding performs rne/rz/rna on the integer bit pattern (add 0x7FFF plus a parity bit, add 0x8000, or mask the low 16 bits), four consecutive ties exhibit the ties-to-even sawtooth, with NaN and overflow handled by side paths; block-scaled FP8-E5M2 quantization picks the 2^e scale from the block absmax via frexp and then snaps to the nearest grid value with ties-to-even over both the normal and the 2^-16 subnormal lattice, so scale adaptation makes the subnormal region unreachable when block=1; stochastic rounding exploits the fact that bf16 grid points are uniform in the high-16-bit integer space, using r=(u32&0xFFFF)/65536 as the probability of rounding up - unbiased sr, zero-biased fwd, away-from-zero bwd - with the noise supplied as an argument so judging stays deterministic; a sharded online softmax rescales each shard's l and exp by m_s-M and merges them into probs and LSE identical to a single full-row pass, with documented handling for +inf rows (an even 1/k split), all -inf rows (NaN probs and a -inf LSE) and NaN rows; the safe p-norm divides every segment by its own maximum magnitude before summing powers, because torch.linalg.norm itself answers inf for [3e154,4e154] and 0.0 for [3e-200,4e-200], and p=inf is precisely the scale factor. Each problem's oracle is structurally independent of the reference solution (math.fsum, two-pass reduction, pure-Python segmented reduction, struct bit patterns, Decimal high-precision powers, grid enumeration with bisect, a single full-row torch computation); shape/dtype/sentinel and ValueError conventions are specified only by the starter docstring, and every example is chosen from integer ratios or exact grid values that can be re-derived on paper.
